note: Hand-made sample in DiagramGen's text-to-diagram style (the official OpenRaiser/DiagramGen files are gated for this HF account). Ground truth is exact because the reference was written from this structure.
instruction: Create a flowchart in LaTeX TikZ for a YouTube summarization pipeline. It has seven nodes: 'YouTube URL' and 'Summary' are ellipses (input and output); 'Fetch captions', 'Whisper fallback', 'Transcript cache', 'Chunk text' and 'Qwen3 summarizer' are rounded rectangles. Directed edges: YouTube URL -> Fetch captions; Fetch captions -> Transcript cache; Fetch captions -> Whisper fallback, labelled 'no captions'; Whisper fallback -> Transcript cache; Transcript cache -> Chunk text; Chunk text -> Qwen3 summarizer; Qwen3 summarizer -> Summary. The main flow runs left to right; place Whisper fallback below Fetch captions. Return one complete, compilable standalone LaTeX document.
